title: Sandpaper friction coefficient
description: Essential: Correctly calculates μ₀ = a₂/g = 0.1 from the deceleration on the sandpaper.

title: Incline acceleration
description: Essential: Correctly determines the acceleration a₁ = 2 m/s² on segment AB from the velocity-time data.

title: Applied force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly solves F = ma₁ + μmg cos α + mg sin α to find F = 14.4 N.

title: Total stopping distance
description: Essential: Correctly sums distances s₁ (AB), s₂ (BC), and s₃ (after C) to find the total distance, rounded to two decimals (2.81 m).

title: Force balance on incline
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law on the incline, identifying all forces (F, gravity, friction).

title: Kinematic analysis phases
description: Important: Correctly segments the motion into accelerated (AB), constant velocity (BC), and decelerated (after C) phases using the data.

title: Velocity at point B
description: Important: Correctly identifies v_B = 1.5 m/s from the data as the transition velocity between segments.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (m, s, kg, N) throughout all calculations.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for acceleration on the incline or during deceleration, leading to incorrect force or distance.

title: Friction force miscalculation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculates the friction force on the incline (e.g., uses sin instead of cos for the normal component).
